attribution.note: Zitron's own first-person words in his own newsletter post: "I'm making the call".

semantics.note: "Making the call" plus "will" is a firm, scored forecast. The quantifier, the scope ("some or all" customers) and the end-2026 horizon are kept. The stated reason ("reckon with true costs") is a motive, not a condition, so dropping it is fine.

contract.note: The contract openly flags that 'AI services' and 'token-based billing' are undefined. Any count of a majority would rest on a population the evaluator chooses, not one Zitron gave. Reading the deadline as 2026-12-31 is reasonable.

output.rationale: This is a firm forecast with an end-2026 deadline. The evaluation date is 2026-10-28, so the deadline has not passed and there is no early-resolution rule. The evidence packet is empty. The forecast cannot be scored yet. Even after the deadline, the result would depend on how the evaluator defines the population of 'AI services'.
